title: General best practices for networks
provenance: Original statements written for MoonMind as a declared checklist of common network hardening practice. No benchmark, standard or vendor guidance text is reproduced or paraphrased line by line.
attribution: MoonMind general best practices for networks: original statements by the MoonMind maintainers, Apache-2.0.
conclusions: Per-requirement conclusions over exported device configurations as of their export time. Analyzer checks conclude only for parsed exports in qualified formats; review and record requirements stay with the agent review and the operator. MoonMind did not observe the running devices.
limitations: Evidence is the operator's exports at their stated export times, not the running devices.
Analyzer coverage is qualified on Cisco IOS fixtures only; other formats and real device exports are Unverified until reviewed.
Intent, permissive rules, management exposure, protocols and credentials need agent review, which an evidence-processing policy of disabled or local-only blocks with no fallback.

requirements.title: Filter lines all take effect
requirements.summary: Every line of a filter or access list can match some traffic. A line that earlier lines already cover silently does nothing and is removed or reordered.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the device configuration exports that hold the filters.
requirements.objectiveBasis: The offline analyzer decides this for every parsed export in a qualified format; unparsed or unqualified content leaves it inconclusive.

objectives.description: No filter line is fully covered by earlier lines.

requirements.title: No clear-text protocols through inbound filters
requirements.summary: Filters on inbound interfaces do not let Telnet, FTP or TFTP through; encrypted alternatives carry management and file transfer.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the device configuration exports that hold the inbound filters.
requirements.objectiveBasis: The offline analyzer decides this for every parsed export in a qualified format; unparsed or unqualified content leaves it inconclusive.

objectives.description: No inbound interface filter permits Telnet, FTP or TFTP.

requirements.title: Devices keep time from a time source
requirements.summary: Each device names at least one time source, so its logs and certificates agree with the rest of the estate.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.objectiveBasis: The offline analyzer decides this for every parsed export in a qualified format; unparsed or unqualified content leaves it inconclusive.

objectives.description: Each device names an NTP server.

requirements.title: Devices send logs off the device
requirements.summary: Each device sends its logs to a remote collector, so its events survive the device and can be reviewed.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.objectiveBasis: The offline analyzer decides this for every parsed export in a qualified format; unparsed or unqualified content leaves it inconclusive.

objectives.description: Each device names a remote logging host.

requirements.title: Configurations refer only to what they define
requirements.summary: A configuration does not apply a filter, policy or other structure it never defines; such a reference leaves the intended control absent.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.objectiveBasis: The offline analyzer decides this for every parsed export in a qualified format; unparsed or unqualified content leaves it inconclusive.

objectives.description: No configuration refers to an undefined structure.

requirements.title: Rules enforce the intended segmentation
requirements.summary: The rules between network zones permit what the stated segmentation intends and nothing more.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the configuration exports and a topology or segmentation description.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Agent review of the sanitized exports against the stated intent; no analyzer decides it, so it is never concluded by a check.

requirements.title: Permissive rules have a stated purpose
requirements.summary: Any-to-any and similarly broad rules are rare, and each has a purpose a reviewer can confirm.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the configuration exports and the purpose of broad rules.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Agent review of the sanitized exports against the stated intent; no analyzer decides it, so it is never concluded by a check.

requirements.title: Management access is confined to management networks
requirements.summary: Management services and lines are reachable only from management networks, over encrypted protocols.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the configuration exports and the management network ranges.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Agent review of the sanitized exports against the stated intent; no analyzer decides it, so it is never concluded by a check.

requirements.title: Weak protocols and ciphers are off
requirements.summary: Devices disable protocol versions and ciphers that no longer protect their traffic.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Agent review of the sanitized exports against the stated intent; no analyzer decides it, so it is never concluded by a check.

requirements.title: No default or shared device credentials
requirements.summary: Local accounts are named, individual and protected by strong hashes; vendor defaults and reversible storage are absent.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the configuration exports; secret values are redacted before review.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Agent review of the sanitized exports against the stated intent; no analyzer decides it, so it is never concluded by a check.

requirements.title: An approved configuration standard exists
requirements.summary: The organisation keeps an approved configuration standard for its network devices, which the exports are reviewed against.
requirements.applicability: Every network device or firewall whose exported configuration is in the plan.
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the approved network device configuration standard.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Organisational evidence: an approved record, not a check or an interpretation, decides this.

organisationalEvidence.description: The approved configuration standard for the network devices in scope.
